content.text:
Karpathy is automating the research loop

autoresearch points agents at nanochat experiments on a single GPU, then lets them propose runs, execute training, read results, and iterate. Less “AGI lab in a box,” more a sharp testbed for agentic science: can models do the boring loop without faking progress?

Watch the loop, not the hype.

#ai #llm #machinelearning #aiagents #researchautomation #nanochat #karpathy
